outOfScope: Creating a third Blackboard lane or replacing the existing Research/Worker ownership model.
Making JEV prescribe implementation patches, execute repairs, or become the authority that mutates candidate source.
Changing provider/model selection, JEV scoring prompts, branch protection, or unrelated CI selection behavior.
Treating agent-authored explanation, plans, or proof documents as sufficient evidence of implementation correctness.
Product-runtime feedback/self-improvement semantics inside packages/agentic-system unless research proves a shared primitive is required.
constraints: RESEARCH_SA only until a fresh JEV readiness judgment accepts the exact plan; this registration does not authorize implementation changes.
Preserve the two-lane Research/Worker model; do not create a third lane for supervision.
JEV remains an independent semantic judge and must not become the actor or prescribe code edits; supervisory control consumes its structured findings.
A failed judgment must not grant source-write repair authority until the actor has produced a judgment-bound lookback/reconsideration that changes epistemic state.
Agent-authored prose or artifact existence alone is not implementation evidence and must not satisfy a finding or material-delta check.
CI remains an enforcement/projection surface; local and CI paths must consume one canonical supervision/transition policy rather than separate gate semantics.
invariants: A failed Worker judgment changes epistemic/control state before it can grant source-write repair authority.
Every lookback and subsequent repair is bound to the exact prior judgment, candidate and plan; stale feedback cannot supervise a new subject.
JEV judges claims/evidence independently; the actor owns diagnosis and repair strategy, and self-authored prose cannot substitute for observed evidence.
Re-evaluation requires material progress against prior findings; repeated unchanged failure cannot be converted into progress by retry count.
Local runtime and CI consume one canonical supervision transition policy while CI remains enforcement/projection rather than the feedback-loop owner.
architectureDecisions: D1 — Treat the missing capability as a supervisor-controller problem between JEV judgment publication and Worker repair, not as a stronger evaluator prompt. JEV produces semantic findings; a control contract decides the next cognitive/action obligation.

D2 — Preserve two lanes. Research must decide whether LOOKBACK is represented as a distinct Worker phase or as a mandatory, read-only precondition inside REPAIR; either representation must prevent source-write IMPLEMENT authority before lookback completion.

D3 — A lookback contract must bind the exact evaluation and candidate and capture failed claims, expected-versus-observed evidence, invalidated assumptions, causal diagnosis, strategy revision and expected new evidence. It is an epistemic artifact, not proof of correctness.

D4 — Re-evaluation must require a material delta linked to unresolved findings: candidate/evidence/strategy changes must be explicit and freshness-bound. Cosmetic artifact churn or prose-only changes are no semantic progress.
D5 — Repeated unresolved findings with no material strategy delta must route to strategy reconsideration/escalation rather than unlimited evaluate-repair retries.

D6 — Local execution and CI must share the same transition/validity semantics. CI may project or enforce the resulting supervision state, but should not own a separate decision about what failure means.
D7 — Evidence weighting remains observation-first: exact candidate, executed verification, runtime/test outcomes and grounded evidence dominate actor-authored explanations.
implementationSlices: S1 — Current-loop audit: trace Worker FINDINGS/REPAIR_REQUIRED from JEV publication through delivery context/bootstrap/local execution and CI projection; identify every point that currently turns findings directly back into IMPLEMENT authority.

S2 — Supervisory contract: specify judgment-bound lookback/reconsideration data, next-state mapping for implementation defect / insufficient evidence / plan contradiction, and the exact authority boundary before repair.
S3 — Material-progress contract: specify finding resolution lineage, material-delta rules and repeated-failure escalation so unchanged/cosmetic resubmission cannot advance evaluation.
S4 — Shared local/CI semantics: select one canonical controller/transition seam consumed by local execution and CI projection, then define focused negative tests and Living truth.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: A non-satisfied Worker JEV judgment cannot immediately expose source-write IMPLEMENT authority; the next required obligation is a read-only judgment-bound lookback/reconsideration, after which an explicit control decision may authorize repair.
evidenceRequired: Focused transition tests covering Worker findings publication through derived delivery/bootstrap context and proving no direct FINDINGS→IMPLEMENT path.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: The supervisory lookback is bound to the exact prior judgment, candidate and plan and records failed claims, expected-versus-observed evidence, invalidated assumptions, causal diagnosis, strategy revision and expected fresh evidence; stale or self-authored lookback cannot supervise another candidate.
evidenceRequired: Exact-subject fixtures for valid lookback plus stale-judgment/candidate and prose-only negative cases.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: A new JEV evaluation after failure requires material progress linked to the unresolved findings; unchanged candidate/evidence or a repeated strategy without new causal/evidence basis is rejected as no semantic progress and repeated failure triggers strategy reconsideration.
evidenceRequired: Attempt-lineage fixtures proving unchanged/cosmetic resubmission and repeated identical strategy cannot create a new valid supervision cycle.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Local execution and CI enforcement derive failure/next-state semantics from one canonical supervision policy; CI only projects/enforces the bound state and does not own a separate pass/fail feedback-loop interpretation.
evidenceRequired: Tests or source-level assertions showing both entry paths consume the same controller/transition contract.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Agent-authored explanations and generated artifacts are supervisory context only; they cannot independently satisfy a JEV finding or material-delta requirement without fresh observed evidence bound to the candidate.
evidenceRequired: Negative fixture where explanation/metadata changes but candidate and observed evidence do not, which must remain unresolved.

negativeVerificationCases: A Worker REPAIR_REQUIRED judgment immediately produces an IMPLEMENT action with source-write authority and no lookback.
A prose-only lookback or unchanged candidate/evidence is accepted as material progress and allowed to re-enter JEV.
The same unresolved finding and repair strategy can be retried repeatedly without strategy reconsideration.
Local and CI paths derive different next-state semantics for the same bound JEV judgment.

negativeCaseBindings.testTitle: BB-153 N1 failed JEV cannot return directly to source-write IMPLEMENT
BB-153 N2 prose-only or unchanged resubmission is not material progress
BB-153 N3 repeated unresolved strategy requires reconsideration
BB-153 N4 local and CI consume one supervision transition contract

researchGaps: Audit the exact local runner/bootstrap path after WORKER/REPAIR and identify whether the cleanest representation is a new LOOKBACK phase or a mandatory pre-repair substate/receipt without expanding the two-lane model.
Define the smallest structured lookback contract and failure taxonomy that adds supervisory value without letting JEV prescribe repairs or letting actor-authored diagnosis become proof.
Define material-delta and repeated-failure semantics that are deterministic enough to enforce without rewarding artifact churn or blocking legitimate evidence-only fixes.
Pin the canonical controller seam shared by local execution and CI projection, including how existing REPAIR/JUDGMENT/merge transitions migrate without breaking current delivered tasks.

livingDocs.statement: Living system state describes JEV as a semantic supervisor whose failed judgments require a bound lookback/reconsideration before repair, while CI remains an enforcement projection and generated explanation is not correctness evidence.
